title: Review of lab 1's membrane_evo (SIBDH): the up sweep against the identical-event twin replicates on 2 of 3 surviving fresh seeds, down is purged on 3 of 3, but the selected lineage reaches generation 2 and one seed reverses; Weak
summary: Fresh seeds 31-34, all three arms (up b2=1.3b, identical-event twin b2=b, down) for 40k steps with k2share.py (K2 biomass share and K2-majority cells every 1000 steps; share/), plus labkit packs of up and twin on seeds 31 and 33 (rerun/). Seed 31 goes extinct in every arm. On seeds 32 and 33, high yield sweeps (final K2 share 0.91 and 0.94, 14/17 and 22/23 cells K2-major) against the twin's 0.12 and 0.26; on seed 34 it reverses (0.004 against the twin's 0.10). Down is purged on all 3 surviving seeds (0.00). Variation comes from only 2-4 imposed whole-cell flips per run. On seed 33 the sheet shows the first K2 cells at t~17.5k and K2 cells filling the domain by t~33k, partly as large K2 bodies that fragment; the up arm's labkit lineage reaches max generation 2 (5 persistent splits, merge/split 0.44) while the twin reaches generation 5 (11 persistent splits, 0 merges). The wall channel is 4 phi(1-phi), a contour by construction; the independent link ring L is membrane-like in 35/67 bodies but with rim/core only 1.33.

whether the up sweep is carried by disk-cut fragments (the committee's disturbance-mediated caveat)
verdicts.limitation: 2 of 4 fresh seeds support the up sweep (1 extinct, 1 reversed); variation is 2-4 imposed flips per run, so each sweep descends from very few mutation events; the selected lineage is only generation 2 and merge-heavy in labkit; my share measure counts biomass and K2-majority cells, not merge-aware births and deaths per kind.
